scope: Dense causal Qwen3 high-level inference/strict Context; independent F32/F16 Llama NativeContext caches with explicit nonflash and one generation/batch worker. No full-port gate is closed.
qualifications: The Qwen3 corpus preserves distinct original MSVC/GNU expected profiles. Measured targets require exact bits; portable bounds were not widened.
F16 raw-state preservation covers every half pattern, while execution retains checked nonfinite-result errors. Native NaN-logit parity is not claimed.
Original C defaults remain F16/F16, AUTO and four/four workers. This checkpoint rejects AUTO/ENABLED and other worker counts; separate source-driven flash/microbatch work remains external.
Qwen3 C NativeContext, MoE/VL/Next, dimension arrays and scaled/partial RoPE remain open.

The failed F16 merge preflight assumed the wrong TSV header and wrote no product/draft source; the guarded retry preserved concurrent shard changes.
Previous exact-commit CI first failed before runner allocation with GitHub internal server error and then passed unchanged on attempt two.
